zh: 春天的

ex: Spring is from March to May.

ex: Summer is from June to August.

zh: 秋天，秋季；晚年，渐衰期；秋（从秋分到冬至）
en: the season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves fall from the trees
ex: Autumn is from September to November.
